parts.title: A heavy box – audio
parts.md:
1. 👀👂 **Listen + read.**
2. 👂 **Hide the transcript**, listen again. **Tap a line** to replay it.

listen.text: When Nam got back to Hope Street, a man with a beard and a brown jacket was carrying a big box up the stairs.
Oh, you must be the new neighbour. I'm Raj Patel, Flat 3. Margaret has told me all about you.
Could you give me a hand with this? It's a new TV, and it's heavier than it looks.
Even though he was tired, Nam picked up the other end of the box. Two days in Manchester, and he already knew four people on Hope Street. That felt like a good start.
